sources.producer: Institut National de la Statistique et des Études Économiques et Démographiques (INSEED)
observed_claims: INSEED identifies this as a national population and housing census; its catalog says coverage is the national territory and the lowest geographic level covered by data is the Zone de Dénombrement (ZD).
The catalog requires bibliographic attribution and download-date/source citation. No open redistribution license was identified on the catalog page; it shows no explicit license grant.
sources.use_and_limits: Authoritative census context, but public metadata does not expose a geocoded village gazetteer. ZD coverage and population tabulations do not establish settlement coordinate completeness. Do not retrieve microdata without an authorized access basis.

sources.title: RGPH04 - Rapport d'analyse - thème 8 : Migration et urbanisme
sources.reuse_terms: No explicit open reuse license located in the catalog record; do not redistribute the PDF absent permission.
sources.use_and_limits: A reproducible official restoration endpoint is recorded. The original WordPress upload URL returned 404 during this review; the official NADA catalog download endpoint worked. The report PDF was not text-extracted in this packet, so no detailed count or political interpretation is asserted from it.

observed_claims: Two-stage stratified sample from 380 of the 2017 census ZD; 5,624 households interviewed successfully.
The public variable dictionary for sID_comm_COM2020 includes village name, island/prefecture/commune, village latitude/longitude, accuracy, altitude, timestamp, and separate market coordinates.
The variable page reports 320 valid and 55 missing village latitude records (and the paired longitude variable reports the same counts).
sources.reuse_terms: Portal footer states © Archive nationale de microdonnées, Tous droits réservés; no explicit open data license was identified.
sources.use_and_limits: A useful official point-source lead only. It is a household survey sample, not a complete settlement census; 55/375 village records lack coordinates, and the exact row-level data were not downloaded or retained. The survey's coordinates must not be repurposed as a complete gazetteer.

observed_claims: 320 valid; 55 non-valid village latitude cases; range -12.37814606 to -11.3724041725415.
sources.use_and_limits: Summary metadata only; exact coordinate rows and names were not accessed. Coverage is tied to the survey sample, not all settlements.

observed_claims: The questionnaire/community file exposes village names and parent fields alongside coordinate, accuracy, altitude and timestamp variable definitions.
sources.use_and_limits: Field dictionary does not prove a complete named-settlement roster or redistribution rights. No data rows were accessed.

sources.producer: INSEED with Direction Nationale de la Stratégie Agricole et de l'Élevage (DNSAE)
sources.reference: COM-INSEED-RGA2-2025-v1.0; agricultural campaign 2023-2024; metadata version dated 2026-04-15 and published/updated 2026-05-20
observed_claims: The catalog describes island, prefecture, commune and village/locality fields, 964 ZD, and claims village/community coordinates were systematically collected.
The operation covers three islands under national administration; its stated population includes agricultural households and local communities, while the household sector is sampled.

Access requires a registered account, an access request describing research and affiliation, a confidentiality commitment and no onward sharing without INSEED permission. Geographic identifiers are said to be aggregated for anonymity. Copyright states Tous droits réservés.
sources.use_and_limits: The strongest recent official lead, but not presently a lawful reusable gazetteer: coordinate rows, exact locality roster, code lineage and spatial granularity are not public in the inspected metadata; terms are restricted/all-rights-reserved. Metadata wording about coordinates and aggregated identifiers needs source-owner clarification before use. No access request or redistribution was made.

sources.license: CC BY-IGO (as declared by parent packet HDX metadata; preserve attribution and any upstream terms)
sources.use_and_limits: Reproduced administrative names, p-codes and parent fields. These are polygons for administrative units, not settlement points. No ADM4/ADM5 or locality coordinate layer is present in the retained package; structural 3/17/55 counts do not establish gazetteer completeness or current legal boundaries.

Specification treats each admin feature as one administrative polygon; local concepts vary by country. Village/locality is only a possible ADM5 concept when available. This is a data specification, not proof that Comoros has an ADM5 locality layer.
